high_level_description: The image is a table titled "Global MAUs," which stands for Monthly Active Users. The table provides data on the number of monthly active users for various AI-related services from January 2025 to November 2025. The columns represent different services, and the rows represent the months. Columns: Date: Lists the months from January 2025 to November 2025. ChatGPT: Shows the number of monthly active users for ChatGPT. Microsoft 365 Copilot: Displays the number
